ai_review.summary: Rough recording quality but stellar jams featuring Easy Wind, The Other One/Cryptical and a monster Turn on Your Lovelight
ai_review.review: The reviewer highlights exceptional performances of Easy Wind, the The Other One into Cryptical sequence, and an extended Turn on Your Lovelight jam, calling them “beyond category.” However, they note that the sound quality is rough, which detracts from the listening experience despite the musical gems. Overall the show shines musically while the tape struggles technically.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief review; reviewer praises the music strongly but flags poor sound quality, leading to a moderate rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer describes the sound as rough, indicating low fidelity or clarity despite the strong performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on pacing; reviewer focuses on the highlighted jams.
